original_test_intent: Validate PCIe Gen5 interoperability of each approved NVIDIA endpoint path with its actual upstream root port, retimer/switch/partner and firmware combination using the vendor NVDiag FCT, then prove the complete path and SUT remain healthy.
original_method: Pin NVDiag/module/config and approved topology/firmware matrix; map every endpoint, upstream component and link; preserve capability/negotiation and error baseline; drain jobs; run each approved interop combination under watchdog with full log and side-effect monitoring; apply only enumerated SKU exceptions, reconcile complete matrix, re-read every path and perform defined post-usability checks.
manual_activity: PCIe/platform owner supplies the complete supported partner/firmware matrix, approved NVDiag module and explicit SKU exception/usability rules and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Signed pinned NVDiag/FCT interop artifact and config
Complete endpoint/root-port/retimer/switch/partner topology and firmware matrix
Stable BDF/serial/slot identities and supported Gen5 capabilities
Exact SkuCheck exception list and per-combination pass oracle
Dedicated window, drained jobs, watchdog, OOB and recovery plan
safety_requirements: No floating latest or generic substitute module
Verify complete physical/logical path before each run
Monitor link, GPU, peer, driver, AER/XID and management state
Stop on retrain/reset/link loss/error or unexpected peer impact
Preserve first failure and never clear logs or automatically retry combinations
agent_execution_scope: Run only approved matrix cells sequentially
Collect full per-cell and post-path health evidence
Stop/escalate and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve precise SKU exception and workable-SUT oracle
Disposition failed/skipped paths and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level module name lacks executable vendor configuration and complete topology coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the pinned vendor NVDiag `pcie_gen5_interop` FCT for each confirmed matrix cell, preserving exact argv/config and complete unfiltered log; do not replace with linkup or bandwidth tests.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Interop identity, ten-minute attendance and twenty-minute machine estimate remain; exact matrix runtime follows approved configuration.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute and reconcile a matrix keyed by stable endpoint/path/partner/firmware identities with pre/post negotiated link, full FCT result and error/usability outcome per cell.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines interoperability as multi-component matrix coverage rather than a single generic pass string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Gen5 linkup proves negotiation, not interoperability across partner/retimer/switch firmware combinations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor FCT may reset/retrain shared paths; topology isolation and matrix sequencing determine blast radius.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner defines which physical and firmware partner combinations are required or unsupported; omissions must be explicit, not silent skips.
expected_evidence: NVDiag build/module/config hashes and vendor support
Complete expected interop matrix with stable topology identities and firmware versions
Pre-run capabilities/negotiated states and AER/XID/dmesg/BMC baseline
Per-cell exact argv, full FCT output, status, duration and permitted SKU exception

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests Gen5 interop FCT and pass/usability; the matrix and exception are underdefined prerequisites, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor artifact/topology/matrix and policy are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Preserves interop-specific coverage and turns an unqualified FCT pass into traceable complete partner/path matrix results.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe interoperability depends on both ends and intervening components, including their firmware and signal path; a GPU linking to one root port cannot represent other retimer/switch combinations. A diagnostic pass string needs a topology binding and complete matrix reconciliation. SKU exceptions can hide a mismatched platform, so only explicitly scoped known exceptions are allowed, and the SUT must be proven usable at the same paths after any retrain/reset.
